messages:
zoe (Design): quick copy nit — the "Preview" tooltip on the evals dropdown reads 'Preview results' but when we tested, users thought it previewed the prompt not the model outputs. :thinking_face:
leah (PM): hmm. maybe we should say 'Preview model outputs' or 'View sample outputs' to be explicit.
mike (Frontend): trivial to change tooltip text, but we need to keep it short to avoid layout overflow. Tooltip CSS max-width is 220px.
sam (a11y): tooltip should also be accessible: use aria-describedby from the button to the tooltip content, and ensure it appears on focus. avoid relying only on title attribute.
zoe (Design): propose options: 'Preview model outputs' (short) or 'View sample outputs for this model' (longer). prefer first for compactness.
leah (PM): agree on 'Preview model outputs'. also add a small helper under the dropdown: 'Shows example responses generated by the selected model.'
mike (Frontend): will update tooltip text and add aria-describedby id for the helper copy. will test with narrow widths.
design-bot: reminder: update copy table and Figma token 'Tooltip / short info' by @zoe.
sam (a11y): once PR is up I'll run VoiceOver and NVDA checks to confirm announce behavior. also add a cypress step to assert helper is linked via aria-describedby.
zoe (Design): thanks — small wins but saves confusion in tests. :sparkles:
